verdict.rationale: Linear's changelog says the mobile app can be used to review code changes, comment on specific lines, and iterate with Linear Agent, which matches every element of the story. Supporting docs show code review happening inside Linear (Guided Reviews, rich diff rendering, GitHub review integration) and Linear Agent writing code. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the mobile review and line-comment workflow beyond a single changelog line, detail on how line comments trigger agent iteration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
